about: What bites on the sky islands (Shattered Planet). Original species. The first four are native lake fish: each island's seed chemistry (tools/blender/island_chemistry.py, water.fish) stocks two of them, and they bite only in their seasons (tools/economy/colony_ledger.py FISH_SEASON). Fish with 'spots' are visitors that come with a fishing spot (ADR-066): the rainbow eel rides the sky river at dusk, the basin ray glides in the ocean basin. weight, night_weight and window_s mean the same as in prism-fish.json. Read by com.daedalus.world.fishing (IslandFishery).

fish.name: rillperch
fish.note: a quick brown perch that noses up the island rills in spring

fish.name: glassfin
fish.note: see-through fins that catch the cloud light

fish.name: skytrout
fish.note: speckled like a dusk sky; leaps the waterfall lip

fish.name: ember_koi
fish.note: glows faintly orange under winter ice

fish.name: rainbow_eel
fish.note: rides the sky river at dusk, every colour at once

fish.name: basin_ray
fish.note: a flat grey glider of the ocean basin
